name: Samtex Fashions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Samtex Fashions Ltd is engaged in manufacturing of ready-made garments and trading activity of food grains.
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Samtex Fashions Ltd is set up in Noida Special Economic Zone, which is a free trade zone. Company has a technical collaboration with Samsung Inc., Korea. Company exports to stores in USA, Europe as well as domestic premium brands in fashion industry.  Company opened an office in New York and is recognized by Government of India as an Export House.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
